# Code Akos

> Self-hosted, Sentry-compatible error tracking in one Node 24+ process with SQLite. Groups events from Sentry SDKs, opens one GitHub issue per new group that has a stack trace, and has an LLM attempt a fix in a git worktree that it opens as a pull request. The model runs through Ollama (default qwen2.5-coder:7b), DeepSeek or Anthropic. Source-available under FSL-1.1-ALv2, not OSI open source.

Facts that are easy to get wrong:

- Grouping key: exception type + crashing file + that frame's source line text (not line number); the SDK `fingerprint` overrides it.
- Triage tags (bot-safe, needs-human, infrastructure, third-party, no-stack-trace, test-event) do not gate the resolver; it attempts every open issue Code Akos filed.
- The resolver's agent has read_file, list_directory, grep and edit_file, no shell; up to 20 turns per attempt; at most 3 failed attempts per issue.
- Install: the desktop app from the latest release (https://ayesh96.github.io/code-akos/installation/) (macOS .dmg for Apple Silicon or Intel, Windows .exe, Linux AppImage); it bundles its own Node and needs only git. Running from source (Node 24+) is for servers and development.
- GitHub only (GitHub Enterprise Server via ORCH_GITHUB_API_URL); no GitLab or Bitbucket.
- No tracing, session replay, alert rules or multi-user accounts. Windows, Linux and Intel Mac desktop builds untested. Fix success rate not measured.

## Docs

- [Installation](https://ayesh96.github.io/code-akos/installation/): download, first open on macOS, Windows and Linux, model setup, the four-step setup window.
- [Getting started](https://ayesh96.github.io/code-akos/getting-started/): GitHub token permissions, adding a project, SDK code for Python, Node.js and the browser, a test event, the path to a pull request.
- [Using the dashboard](https://ayesh96.github.io/code-akos/usage/): projects overview, error list and filters, triage, resolver and pull request details, settings.
- [Download](https://github.com/Ayesh96/code-akos/releases/latest)
- [Sentry alternatives compared](https://ayesh96.github.io/code-akos/sentry-alternative/): scope and comparison with Sentry, GlitchTip, Bugsink; licensing.
- [Self-hosted error tracking](https://ayesh96.github.io/code-akos/self-hosted-error-tracking/): listeners, data folder, what leaves the machine.
- [Sentry errors to GitHub issues](https://ayesh96.github.io/code-akos/sentry-errors-to-github-issues/): grouping, filing rules, issue contents, token permissions.
- [AI bug fixes as pull requests](https://ayesh96.github.io/code-akos/ai-bug-fix-pull-requests/): attempt selection, agent loop, pull request contents, cost, comparison with Sentry Seer.
- [Error triage with Ollama](https://ayesh96.github.io/code-akos/local-llm-error-triage/): providers, tags, guardrails, measured results.
- [FAQ](https://ayesh96.github.io/code-akos/faq/): licensing, privacy, supported SDKs, GitHub only, cost.
- [Reference](https://ayesh96.github.io/code-akos/reference/): every setting and the security model.
